explanation: Use Pascal’s identity C(n,k)=C(n−1,k)+C(n−1,k−1), stopping at k=0 or k=n. Memoize the recursive results in a two-dimensional table. The file also includes a separate space-efficient alternative.
timeComplexity: O(n(k+1)) time for the called memoized implementation.
spaceComplexity: O(n(k+1)) table space and O(n) recursion space.
